privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Collaby handles data inside the current educational prototype.

sections.title: 1. General context
body: Collaby is an educational prototype created as part of a graduation project. This document explains which kinds of data may be used in the demonstration build and how the team treats that data.

sections.title: 2. What data may be processed
list: Account data entered during sign-up and sign-in.
Test projects, tasks, messages, and profile data created to demonstrate the product flow.
Technical information related to the interface, routing, and server-side components.

sections.title: 3. Why the data is used
list: To demonstrate the prototype user flows.
To verify authentication, routing, and in-app actions.
To debug and analyze the educational version of the project.

sections.title: 4. Current limitations
body: Collaby is not a production service and is not intended to store sensitive corporate data. Use only demo-safe and non-critical information in this educational environment.

sections.title: 5. Access and deletion
body: If you have questions about demonstration data or want to clarify how information is used in the educational build, contact the team through the public channels listed below.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: What this educational prototype is intended for and how it should be used.

sections.title: 1. Project status
body: Collaby is an educational prototype created as part of a graduation project. By using the website and application, you acknowledge the demo nature of this version.

sections.title: 2. What the prototype is for
body: The prototype is intended to demonstrate interfaces, architecture, and user scenarios. It is not offered as a finished commercial service for permanent business use.

sections.title: 3. Usage limitations
list: Do not use the project to store sensitive working data.
Do not expect commercial support, uptime guarantees, or production-level stability.
Do not attempt to access other users' data or demonstration accounts without authorization.

sections.title: 4. Content and code
body: Design assets, texts, source code, and other materials are part of the graduation project and may change while the team prepares the final defense version.

sections.title: 5. No production guarantees
body: The project is provided as a demonstration build. The team does not promise uninterrupted availability, commercial fitness, or compatibility with every real business workflow.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: What browser data the prototype uses to keep the experience stable.

sections.title: 1. What matters here
body: Collaby is an educational prototype, so this cookie policy only describes the basic browser-side data needed for the interface and demo scenarios to work correctly.

sections.title: 2. What may be stored in the browser
list: Technical data related to sign-in and the current session.
Interface preferences such as theme and language.
Temporary UI data that helps the demo flows remain stable.

sections.title: 3. What is not used here
body: The landing page and prototype do not claim the use of advertising cookies, third-party marketing pixels, or commercial tracking scripts.

sections.title: 4. Cookie management
body: You can delete cookies through your browser settings. After that, parts of the educational prototype related to sign-in or interface preferences may require you to sign in again.
